decisions.reason: The page-limit effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including reduced spacing and possible client content reduction.
Reducing section and paragraph spacing does not change photo selection or photo-integration requirements.
The spacing reduction does not alter the Agua Arc identity or required brand assets.
The one-page cover-letter requirement is a separate clause already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE; the source spacing modification does not change it.
General spacing reduction does not change which tables must be integrated or replaced.
Document spacing does not change the required PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export properties.
The spacing modification does not affect Canva source access, ownership, editability, or asset policy.
The client's conditional offer to reduce content during review does not currently change the narrative-integration or fixed-section-order requirements.
Reducing document spacing has no necessary effect on the requirement that saved PDF hyperlinks remain functional.
The source decision concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not modify the TPEC proposal.
Mentioning the client's upcoming review does not change the agreed count of one consolidated revision round.
The spacing request does not change any draft, revision, submission, or deadline date.
